_comment: Music timing + state machine (placeholder mechanical names — owner order). M1 spike 05 reads timing/transition/stems.freq_hz — those fields are load-bearing for the regression floor. M2 adds: states (one stem per state; null = silence), initial state, per-stem file refs into fixtures.json. Transitions are quantized to the next bar boundary at least one tick ahead and fully scheduled via absolute-clock calls (spike 05 pattern), never adjusted afterwards. A transition arriving while one is pending is ignored (deterministic policy, documented).
